parameters.question: Compare NMF W matrices (samples x 3 metagene activation scores) from n_components=3, init='nndsvda' on log2(x+1)-transformed gene expression. Each sample's scores must match the reference within +/-0.05 absolute tolerance; column order and component label naming may differ, so align components by values rather than names.

NMF (n_components=3, init='nndsvda') on log2(x+1)-transformed gene expression; compare the H gene-loadings matrix. Each gene's loading must match the reference within 5% relative absolute error. Metagene rows and gene columns may be in a different order, so match metagenes to their best-corresponding reference rows before comparing values.
